Hi Faiza,

lam writing to contest HR’s and both executives attempting to accuse me of abandonment of employment. | will
seek legal counsel due to disagreements with multiple aspects of this letter, such as the dates and the fact that | am
a protected employee who has provided a work capacity certificate. | am currently undergoing medical treatment
with an upcoming psychiatric appointment, which can be confirmed as of last month.

| fully intend to file both stop harassment and bullying case and employment protection case to industrial relations
against Human Resources if this continues. | believe this letter has been issued without proper diligence and due
process, aiming to avoid overturning liability.

Currently, the industrial relations department has accepted the review, which | seek to overturn the liability factor.
This does not mean that | am no longer an employee without an injury that should be denied any leave. Documents
have been supplied so leave and payments must be actioned. The breach is with my employer not paying my
entitlements yet continue to do so.

Throughout this process, | have communicated through my doctor and WorkCover, and QLD Health has been given
updates at every step. However, Human Resources have purposely delayed and coerced the outcome of the
WorkCover claim, with correspondence twice exceeding a month over the 5 days allowed.

Please let me know if you would like an update on my medical treatment. However, | cannot follow the directive in
this letter as it breaches the Fair Work Act, Industrial Relations Act, Human Rights, and the EB11 HHS agreement.
There are general protections for employees suffering from an injury, and although the review process will seek
clarification on liability, WorkCover has given QLD Health an outcome letter and correspondence acknowledging a
‘personal injury’ while making no accommodations for me and disregarding any injury or work capacity certificates
supplied to Human Resources. | find this letter disrespectful to my dignity and health.

| also find it extremely offensive and inappropriate to include the fact that | took leave when my grandfather died in
this letter or in making any decision or directive regarding employment abandonment following a communication to
return to work. This letter is antagonistic and lacks legal justification, which would understandably trigger anyone.

| also request again, following many emails to Ms. Taylor, Ms. Reece, Ms. Stibbard, and Amy Mo from WorkCover,
that fatigue pay be issued, referencing the outcome of the WorkCover notice to be paid overtime when allowing an
employee less than 10 hours between shifts. Chloe allowed me only 7 hours, not including travel time. Not issuing
payments and entitlements constitutes wage theft, and | have already submitted a crime and corruption complaint
against QLD Health employees.

Additionally, | formally request that my leave be processed and that HR and executives respect their legal, ethical,
and contractual obligations and responsibilities prior to any legal action.

Thank you for your time. Please leave a voicemail when calling, and | will return your phone call. | have not received
any calls from the contact number provided here. | have been using WorkCover and my doctor to communicate with
my employer, essentially through a third party, to provide updates. As a relevant contact has not been provided to
me following my grievances with Ms. Reese and Ms. Taylor. | also note the false dates of contact included in this
letter. | can supply additional evidence in response to this, but it has been advised to Ms Taylor that HR would
receive information and updates through WorkCover, including a work capacity certificate. Therefore, Ms. Taylor or
HR choosing to ignore communication does not meet the criteria for abandonment of employment of an injured
employee unable to communicate effectively.
| also accept communication via telephone and email, though | prefer email from those who do not seek to
antagonize my injury or cause mental or financial harm. If you wish to schedule a time to contact me by phone, you
can reach me at 0422 438 627.

Regards,

Cory
